name: encoding-reflection-interface-field-store-shapes
description: A value the program stores in an interface-typed field, element or value of a type an encoder walks reaches the encoder whatever expression stores it: a conversion to an interface type, a call of several results assigned to the field or to an index of a container, a call returning a container of interface values, and a variable the value was first stored in. Each such type keeps the fields the encoder reads. A value stored the same way in a struct nothing encodes keeps nothing, and its field written once is reported write-only.
